issue.title: fix(compiler): Generates function expressions as returning any
issue.body:


**What is the current behavior?** (You can also link to an open issue here)

As in #9875, function expressions are sometimes generated as returning `void` when they return an expression producing a type error in the generated code.

**What is the new behavior?**

Functions are generated as returning `any` instead of `void`.

**Does this PR introduce a breaking change?** (check one with "x")

```
[ ] Yes
[x] No
```

**Other information**:

Function expressions are used in an expression context so untyped
function expressions should have any as the result type.

Fixes: #9875

body: Left open for @tbosch to review fix.

From @tbosch:

Could we change the fix to do the following:
- keep the ts emitter as is, i.e. emit a `void` if no return type is given in the output ast. So we stay in sync with the other codegen places where omitting the type means `void` (we also don't have a type of `void` in the OutputAst`).
- change the part that creates the output ast to create a `FunctionExpr` with a `DYNAMIC_TYPE` as return type. By adding `o.DYNAMIC_TYPE` as 3rd argument to the `o.fn` call that is passed to `mapNestedViews` in `compile_query.ts` [here](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/modules/@angular/compiler/src/view_compiler/compile_query.ts#L108).

**What is the current behavior?** (You can also link to an open issue here)

Revert of a previous fix and replaced with the recommended fix from @tbosh. 

The function expressions generated for view queries didn't specify a type which results in them being given the `void` type.

**What is the new behavior?**

View query function expressions are now explicitly given the dynamic type which is `any` in TypeScript.

**Does this PR introduce a breaking change?** (check one with "x")

```
[ ] Yes
[x] No
```

**Other information**:

Fixes: #9875
